author: GamingBolt
description:
The leveling journey of World of Warcraft: Forever definitely has more going for it than just nostalgia for a game released in 2004. Thanks to all of the new content that has been added to the game, Blizzard has managed to once more introduce a sense of mystery and adventure to an experience that had at one point become “solved”, and as a result, quite stale. 

In its current state, I plan to continue spending countless more hours with the title, and it’s an easy game to recommend to anyone else who likes the feeling of being a simple adventurer in a massive world rather than a hero that has to deal with universe-ending threats on a monthly basis.
title: World of Warcraft Forever Review in Progress - This Is Peak WOW

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake has done well to draw in some serious crowds to Hyrule, a place that’s very familiar but now comes with a fresh new layer of current-gen goodness for the Switch 2. It isn’t really surprising, then, that the game has done as well as it has, and we’re quite interested in thinking about what that might mean for the future of the franchise.

Can the remake be the catalyst for Nintendo deciding that the Zelda franchise needs a brand-new title? What would it learn from the remake if it did go ahead with such a venture? We’ve given it a lot of thought, so join us and ruminate on what a new title in the long running franchise could bring to the table.
title: The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake Sold Over 5 Million Copies - Now Make a New Zelda Like It

author: GamingBolt
description:
Grand Theft Auto VI is poised to be more than one of the biggest gaming releases in living memory, but transcend beyond the gaming space toward a worldwide cultural event. Whether you think that’s hyperbolic or not, you can’t deny there’s going to be millions of players who are already thinking about how they’ll get ready in real-life to make the most of every second once GTA 6 releases. 

A game of this magnitude takes preparation, but even if you’re only casually dipping into Vice City you’ll find something useful in this feature. Some of this advice is a little tongue-in-cheek, sure, but we’re excited, you’re excited; let’s get to it.
title: GTA 6 Is Coming -  Get These 10 Things Done ASAP
